_comment: The book routes to the shared `compsci` theme (autoTheme matches \bict\b), which
is right for the palette and layout but carries the subject name "Computer
Science". This manuscript is not Computer Science: its own title page reads
"INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY FORM 2", and it says ICT 121 times
against Computer Science twice. Without this the cover, title page and running
header all called the book Computer Science.

Rebuilt 2026-10-23 on the current engine: two empty "Performance Levels" headings in Sub-Topic 2.2.1 (no table under them in the manuscript) removed; LEARNINING/Alterative typos corrected; one column split for every rubric (uniformRubrics); glossary and references set a little tighter together (backmatterSpacing) so neither runs two entries onto a page of its own.
Foreword signatory set like the Preface and Acknowledgement ones (bold name, title and organisation in bold capitals): the manuscript typed it with no bold, and its title in mixed case.

Post-CDC edition (2026-11-06): the .docx is the editor's return with the guide applied: blue text deleted, yellow text kept, highlights cleared. Exercises 8 and 12 lost their screenshots, so the imageToTable grids are gone. "Is this conversation helpful so far?" was pasted chatbot text, left out of the .docx.

keepListNumbers: answers carry Word's own numbers, with steps restarting at 1 as sub-lists, so they match the questions. Exercise 13 (2.2.3): answer 2's number sat on the question line the editor deleted, so "2." was typed back on "The four slides could be:" in the .docx.
End of Topic 2.1 answer 4: Word's "4." sat on the first practice and "2." was typed on the second, so the .docx sets a bare "4." with practices 1 and 2 under it.

Sub-Topic 2.1.1 Exercise 6: the heading was typed twice in a row; the repeat is left out of the .docx. listAnswers: six items Word keeps in the same list as the steps above them but which open a new answer.

One look (2026-11-06, user: everything standard, which words bold and which not): boldLabels, one 'Suggested Responses' form, Activity 8's labels without numbers, the REFER lines as the plain sentence under the box, Exercise 9's table body not bold. Numbered steps with a teacher's note under them stay bold: all 38 are.
Topic 2.4's End of Topic Assessment was typed bold from start to end, unlike the other three: plainParts.
